# prism

<!-- ops:identity start — generated by ops-docs; edit identity.toml -->
One store of desktop look settings (glass optics, focus ring, gaps, terminal opacity), saved as named profiles and per-wallpaper adjustments, resolved into one set of values and rendered into each target's configuration. Its first desktop is niri with the native glass material, tuned live from a Noctalia shell panel or the `prism` command line.

Authority: `docs/store.md`, `docs/definitions.md`, `docs/noctalia-plugin.md`
<!-- ops:identity end -->

## Setup

Prism currently targets Linux with [niri-material](https://github.com/khughitt/niri-material),
Node.js 20 or newer, and optional native [Noctalia v5](https://github.com/noctalia-dev/noctalia)
for its panel and wallpaper/palette hooks. Stock niri cannot apply the material.
The visual bus is intended to support other desktops; see
[direction and current limits](docs/desktop.md#direction-and-limits).

```sh
git clone https://github.com/khughitt/prism.git
cd prism
npm ci
mkdir -p ~/.local/bin
ln -s "$PWD/bin/prism" ~/.local/bin/prism
prism doctor
```

Keep that directory on PATH. Complete [desktop setup](docs/desktop.md) for the
niri include, optional panel registration and palette hooks; doctor reports
outstanding requirements. Without Noctalia, select manual tint as described there.

Development also needs Lua, just, Python 3.11 or newer, bash and zsh. Use
`just test-one <files>` while editing, `just test-plugin-lua` for the standalone
plugin checks, and `just check` for mandatory hygiene and guide checks.
`just test-full` deliberately runs the complete Node and Lua suite. Ordinary
`just test` and `just test-fast` observe the code checkout's .tt.toml; it is
configured to skip automatic local broad runs. Focused checks and mandatory hygiene
still execute; policy skips are reported separately from test results.

The qualified GitHub workflow runs one Linux suite per origin branch push, including
nested names, with superseded runs cancelled. Tags and other remotes are uncovered.
Its pinned renderer checkout makes the schema comparison explicit;
it omits the one Noctalia CLI palette test and private task-record checks. CI uses
Lua 5.4; the development host uses Lua 5.5.1. Noctalia's plugin runtime is Luau, so
neither offline interpreter certifies live desktop integration.
[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) describes the gates, setup and coverage limits.

## Usage

Set makes a pending edit and applies it; commit keeps it in the look; revert
reveals the saved values:

```sh
prism set glass.roughness 0.4
prism commit base
prism set glass.roughness 0.2
prism reset revert
```

Use `prism --help` and `prism <command> --help` for the command surface.
The panel offers the same edits and keep/reset actions over visible controls.

- [Usage](docs/usage.md): commands, look selection, wallpaper pairs, starter profiles,
  reset modes, migration and rollback.
- [Store](docs/store.md): records, resolution, reserved state, guarded writes and recovery.
- [Definitions](docs/definitions.md): parameters, sink/rack contracts, fixed pipeline
  order and the test-checked interaction matrix.
- [Desktop](docs/desktop.md): compositor, Kitty, panel, palette, tint and recovery.
- [Noctalia plugin](docs/noctalia-plugin.md): model exchange, serialized writes,
  reconciliation, rendering and host limits.

## Layout

- `bin/prism` and `src/` — launcher, store, resolution, commands and sink runner.
- `defs/` — parameter definitions and the renderer-owned rack pipeline copy.
- `integrations/` — niri, Kitty, debug backdrop and the Noctalia panel plugin.
- `resources/profiles/` — starter look snapshots.
- `test/`, `test-support/` — tests and supporting workers/reporters.
- `docs/` — current public references.
- `tools/` — vendored shared tooling; see [its maintenance rules](tools/README.md).

## Consumers

- `dots` — its launcher resolves the installed Prism checkout and puts the CLI on PATH.
